label: Every word on the How to Use pages screen
aliases: how to use pages screen words

params.name: lede
params.default: The training links behind each screen's How to Use button. One link is a button; several become a menu. {covered} of {total} {total:page|pages} have one.

params.name: hint
params.default: Paste a YouTube address, a video file, a manual published on this portal (/m/…) or any web page.

params.name: label_placeholder
params.default: What it is, e.g. Two-minute tour

params.name: remove_body
params.default: “{label}” leaves this page's How to Use button when you press Save.

params.name: empty_body
params.default: Without one, this page shows no How to Use button.

params.name: saved_live
params.default: Saved. The How to Use button is live.

params.name: saved_none
params.default: Saved. This page has no How to Use button now.

params.name: no_recordings
params.default: No recording to pick yet - make one in Videos.

params.name: gm_none
params.default: This page has no Guide me tour yet. Import a Guide me script to add the button.

params.name: gm_have
params.default: {title} - {n} {n:step|steps}. The Guide me button is live on this page.

params.name: gm_import_hint
params.default: A Guide me script (.json) from the Guide Me Builder, or one written for this page.

params.name: gm_pick_first
params.default: Choose a script file or paste one first.

params.name: gm_imported_ok
params.default: Guide me imported. The button is live on this page.

params.name: gm_voice_auto
params.default: Best available for the preferred languages

params.name: gm_try_line
params.default: This is how the guide will sound on this page.

params.name: gm_no_speech
params.default: This browser cannot speak aloud; the guide will show the words only.

params.name: gm_open
params.default: Open the page and press Guide me

params.name: gm_remove_body
params.default: This page goes back to the guide it came with, or to none. The imported one stays in the history of Ops & chips.

description_nl: The words of one screen. {placeholders} are filled on the page. A language overrides any of them with chip ui.howto_config.<lang> (for example ui.howto_config.hi).
